defect: published and publicly reachable at $150 with ZERO delivery files. A buyer could pay $150 and receive nothing.

reachability_evidence.product_page: HTTP 200 with a live pk_live_ payment key and purchases_disabled absent
reachability_evidence.storefront: listed in our own storefront, so it is discoverable
reachability_evidence.note: an earlier draft conclusion that it was UNREACHABLE because custom_permalink was empty was WRONG - landing_url is /l/owtmpe. It is reachable. The conclusion was corrected before anything was reported.

pre_existing_protection: the description ALREADY read 'WITHDRAWN - NOT AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE. Galaxy Forge is a digital-products company.' before this cycle touched it. This was not authored here.

action_attempted.what: prepended a stronger notice: explicit do-not-buy, a statement that nothing is downloadable after payment, and a full-refund commitment for anyone who already paid
action_attempted.method: PUT /v2/products/<id> with a flat description key, the same write path proven in cycle 108
action_attempted.verification: API re-read returned the original 83-character description unchanged. A first-pass check that reported 'notice present: True' was a FALSE POSITIVE caused by the original text already containing the phrase 'NOT AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE'. The exact-match re-read is what caught it, and the failure is reported rather than smoothed over.
action_attempted.why_unknown: not determined. The write returned HTTP 200 but changed nothing. Possibly this product is in a state where the description field does not accept updates; not proven.

residual_risk: REAL AND UNMITIGATED. The only protection is a sentence in the description. Gumroad's checkout does not enforce it, so a buyer who reaches /l/owtmpe can still complete a $150 purchase and receive nothing. Nothing available through the public API closes this.
founder_action_required: احذف المنتج من لوحة Gumroad أو عطّل نشره. The API exposes no working unpublish: POST /v2/products/<id>/disable returns 404, and the description field does not accept writes for this product. This is an account-level action only the founder can take.
not_done_deliberately: the price was NOT changed to zero and the title was NOT altered. Editing a commercial surface without a working, verified mechanism would produce a false sense of having fixed something. The defect is documented precisely instead.
